## Current development phase: early prototype

- Implement only the requested functionality. Keep changes small.
- Do not create or extend automated tests unless explicitly requested.
- Do not run builds, test suites, linting, formatting or type-check
  commands unless explicitly requested.
- Do not repeatedly poll or restart development servers.
- Verify changes by inspecting the relevant code and diff.
- Provide a short manual verification checklist.
- State clearly which checks were not run.
- If a change needs automated verification to resolve a specific
  uncertainty, explain why and ask before running it.
- Do not fix unrelated issues or perform unsolicited refactoring.
- Keep progress updates and the final summary concise.
